title: Add workload runners, profiling baselines, and reporting pipeline for benchmark lab
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR introduces the first-class workload runners, profiling baselines, and an automated reporting pipeline for the benchmark-lab repository. Motivation: we need repeatable, representative workloads and stable profiling baselines to measure regressions in serving runtime optimizations and scheduling changes. The change set includes: a set of canonical workload runners (text-generation, chat-stream, embedding-batch, rerank) with configurable QPS/latency targets; a baseline profiler harness that captures CPU/GPU timelines, memory/kv-cache footprint, kernel counters and summarized P50/P95/P99 token latencies; a nightly reporting pipeline that aggregates results into the existing benchmark DB and emits CSV/JSON reports and Slack summaries; CI integration to run lightweight smoke benchmarks on PRs with opt-in labels; documentation and quickstart for running locally and in CI. See linked Linear items ENG-423 and ENG-430 for acceptance criteria and evaluation suite definitions.
commits_summary: 6 commits: initial workload runner implementations; add profiler harness and baseline collectors; reporting pipeline and db ingest; CI integration and small refactors; docs and example config; fix test flakes discovered in CI.
